setup_and_data.title: Keep a complete permitted player
setup_and_data.instruction: On Windows, select BodyHarvestRecompiled.exe in your existing permitted copy; on native Linux x64, select BodyHarvestRecompiled. Keep its complete extracted folder and supplied assets/libraries together as the working directory. macOS uses the upstream application bundle. Linux ARM64 and Flatpak are separate upstream packages and preparation routes; Windows launch details do not apply to them.

setup_and_data.title: Select your original game on first Play
setup_and_data.instruction: Choose Play explicitly, then Load ROM in the player and select your own North American Body Harvest cartridge dump. Upstream accepts .z64, .n64 and .v64 byte orders, checks the game identity and remembers a normalized bh.us.z64 copy. The released player needs no separate compiler or original-game installer.

setup_and_data.title: Preserve the actual profile and working copy
setup_and_data.instruction: You or upstream provide updates. Keep the complete copy and actual profile: normally %LOCALAPPDATA%\BodyHarvestRecompiled, ~/.config/BodyHarvestRecompiled, or ~/Library/Application Support/BodyHarvestRecompiled. On Windows/native Linux, portable.txt uses the working folder; on macOS the marker and data belong beside the application bundle. Preserve the ROM copy, saves, settings, bindings and mods, including any APP_FOLDER_PATH override. These external files are outside Portcove backup and rollback.

setup_and_data.title: Keep Flatpak data with the actual profile
setup_and_data.instruction: For an existing permitted Flatpak installation, follow upstream preparation and preserve the complete ~/.var/app/io.github.bodyharvestrecomp.bodyharvestrecomp folder alongside the actual profile. Its writable app area and normal/custom/portable profile can be different. Keep the working installation until its replacement is ready.

shared_component.evidence: Body Harvest and sciaschi pin the dependency as a submodule; Reloaded pins it in both supported setup scripts, applies local patches and explicitly names the missing upstream license in its package recipe. Parent grants and nested dependency licenses do not establish its separate grant. This is an unresolved acquisition fact, not a claim that permitted existing copies cannot work.
shared_component.profile_boundary: Pinned file.cpp uses HOME/.config on Linux rather than XDG_CONFIG_HOME. APP_FOLDER_PATH/custom/portable coordinates can differ. Windows/native Linux portable marker is relative to cwd; macOS checks beside its app bundle. Body Harvest Flatpak additionally uses writable app data; preserve whole per-app data alongside actual profile.

lineage.review: Reloaded credits and incorporates sciaschi work under its retained MIT attribution. Shared game/dependency/source lineage does not merge canonical identities or transfer qualification. All upstream opaque IDs and existing artwork/lineage remain unchanged.
